identity.question: Iran full airspace closure by October 31, 2026?

rule.window: Created 2026-09-16T17:53:25.865929Z through Oct31 11:59 PM ET = 2026-11-01T03:59Z; Gamma endDate agrees.
rule.yes: Iran initiates non-weather general closure applicable to all commercial flights transiting all Iran/Tehran FIR; limited exceptions may qualify. Partial/local limits, foreign state/airline restrictions, weather/quakes/volcanoes do not. Official Iranian aviation sources and credible-reporting consensus are named.

facts.fact: Reports six-hour full Iran closure under NOTAM, citing Iran Civil Aviation Organization spokesperson via Mehr. Before market creation; historical context only.

Two Iran-bound planes returned to Najaf after Iranian authorities denied entry, reportedly for security. Separate report describes temporary halt in Iraqi civilian air traffic (not a full Iraqi closure). No aviation authority statement or Iranian general-closure claim.
Recommends EASA/TCO operators avoid Tehran FIR at all altitudes for safety reasons. Foreign operator advisory, explicitly insufficient under frozen rule.
